chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: Personnel of the band at the Great White Way
summary: The small band had one trumpet, two saxes, timbales, bass and piano, mostly from Siboney.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Okay. At The Great White Way, you and your orchestra was there without Mario. How many men did you have in that orchestra?
I have one trumpet, two saxes, a timbales, bass, piano and myself.
Okay. Do you remember the names? Were any of them from La Siboney?
Oh, I see. You had Jose Budet?
Jose Budet, ah, Johnny Nieto, he wasn't from Siboney but got together because Alberto Iznaga left the band and —
What about that trumpet player that was very good, Rene Ederia?
Ederia, was he in your group?
I see. You had all those guys then.
